### [Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government](https://www.anthropic.com/news/expanding-partnership-gsa)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-27

Anthropic has expanded its GSA agreement to offer a 40% discount on Claude products across all government levels and direct/cloud purchasing routes.

- Applies a 40% discount to Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API for federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial entities without minimum spend commitments.
- Claude for Government is generally available with FedRAMP High authorization, with select models authorized for DoD IL4 and IL5 workloads on AWS GovCloud.
- Claude Enterprise is currently pursuing FedRAMP Moderate authorization via the FedRAMP 20x program.
- Public sector deployment options include direct purchasing as well as cloud access through Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
- Weekly Claude for Government active users grew eightfold since February, with federal civilian usage increasing 20-fold year-over-year across ~500 government organizations.

**Why it matters:** The expanded agreement lowers financial barriers for public sector entities to deploy FedRAMP-authorized Claude models for sensitive unclassified, DoD IL4/IL5, and code modernization workloads.
